root_cause: A valid fresh LinkedIn organization OAuth proof existed in production, but the setup runtime could still prefer stale oauth_candidate/company_oauth state before the durable verified proof. That left the canonical company setup BLOCKED_AMBIGUOUS and caused the publication claim to remain content_ready with LINKEDIN_REAUTH_REQUIRED even though a verified fresh organization OAuth lineage existed.
prevention_rule: When linkedin-company-oauth-fresh-proof-v1 is VERIFIED and fresh_oauth_verified=true, the setup controller must evaluate and prefer that exact connected_account_id before stale candidate, alias, default-account, or generic ACTIVE discovery. Company readiness remains fail-closed on live ADMINISTRATOR ACL plus organization scopes; provider publication remains owned only by powerhouse-social-publisher; LIVE_PROVEN still requires successful create plus exact provider readback.
